transcript.answer: It happened on 2026-10-16. PR #2787, "Context reads choose a backend: lore, utopia or both", merged that day and added the choice. The same day, ADR-052 was amended with "reads choose a backend". Each context read can now name `lore`, `utopia` or `both`. It can do this per request, or through the repo's `settings.context_backend`, and Lore is the default. The PR said that at the time nothing actually read Utopia yet. It only added the switch, so that each Utopia reader could land behind it later.
